findings.evidence: The creature is shown almost straight-on from the front at near eye level, not the requested front three-quarter view from slightly above, which gives the 3D reconstruction less side information.

findings.evidence: The fins are upward-pointing, inward-hooking horns rather than short backward-curving ear fins.
The left fin sits lower, flares further outward and has its segment band higher than the right fin, which breaks the requested bilateral symmetry in this near-frontal view.
The shell is about as tall as it is wide, not clearly wider than tall as specified.
